fields.label: Config
fields.help: The name of the instance partition's configuration (similar to a region) which defines the geographic placement and replication of data in this instance partition.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The descriptive name for this instance partition as it appears in UIs.

fields.label: Instance
fields.help: The instance to create the instance partition in.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: A unique identifier for the instance partition, which cannot be changed after the instance partition is created.

fields.label: Node Count
fields.help: The number of nodes allocated to this instance partition.

fields.label: Processing Units
fields.help: The number of processing units allocated to this instance partition.

fields.label: Autoscaling Limits
Max Nodes
fields.help: Specifies maximum number of nodes allocated to the instance partition.

fields.label: Max Processing Units
fields.help: Specifies maximum number of processing units allocated to the instance partition.

fields.label: Min Nodes
fields.help: Specifies number of nodes allocated to the instance partition.

fields.label: Min Processing Units
fields.help: Specifies minimum number of processing units allocated to the instance partition.
Defines scale in controls to reduce the risk of response latency and outages due to abrupt scale-in events.

fields.label: Autoscaling Targets
High Priority Cpu Utilization Percent
fields.help: Specifies the target high priority cpu utilization percentage that the autoscaler should be trying to achieve for the instance partition.

fields.label: Storage Utilization Percent
fields.help: Specifies the target storage utilization percentage that the autoscaler should be trying to achieve for the instance partition.

fields.label: Total Cpu Utilization Percent
fields.help: Specifies the target total cpu utilization percentage that the autoscaler should be trying to achieve for the instance partition.
